title: single-lock automatic couplings for push tows for inland navigation, Part 2 Type A couplings
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the main dimensions and other requirements of Type A single-lock automatic couplings intended for a bow-to-stern connection of inland vessels in push tows, navigating in waters with a wave height of not more than 2 m. 1 .2 This standard does not cover side couplings.
clause_3_terminology: lock automatic couplings for push tows for inland navigation

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
